arithmeticDescription: Preserve ordinary finite arithmetic order. Use a scaled same-sign harmonic mean when slope products are subnormal or intermediate arithmetic overflows, bounded by the larger finite secant. Factor only nonfinite cubic coefficient intermediates. Nonrepresentable coefficients remain invalid; callers retain their existing finite-result evaluation policy.
linearArithmeticDescription: Preserve ordinary Linear and Extend arithmetic order. Retain finite Linear endpoints when their difference cannot form a finite coefficient. Recover failed finite Linear or endpoint-tangent extension arithmetic with an exact binary affine ratio; a nonflat Linear slope rounded to zero uses the endpoint line. Keep exact knots, explicit outside modes and cubic coefficient validation unchanged.
knotPolicy: Numeric equality, including signed zero; exact knots return stored values

interpolation.help: Use the left point between knots; an exact knot uses its own value.
Connect neighboring points with a straight line.
Use a shape-preserving monotone cubic between neighboring points.
Use endpoint slopes and handles one third of the segment width.

handles.help: Follow the curve's monotone slopes; handles cannot be dragged directly.
Keep incoming and outgoing slopes equal when either handle is edited.
Edit incoming and outgoing slopes independently.

outside.help: Outside the domain, use the nearest endpoint value.
Continue the first or last segment's endpoint slope outside the domain.
Repeat beyond the domain; the configured maximum keeps its exact endpoint value.
Reflect the curve on alternating domain intervals.
